entries.source: Designing Calm Technology for the Cities of Tomorrow
entries.target: 为未来城市设计安静的技术

entries.source: How thoughtful interfaces can make urban life quieter, safer and more human.
entries.target: 用心思缜密的界面，让城市生活更安静、更安全、也更有人情味。

entries.source: A research brief by the Urban Systems Lab. Written for city makers, service designers and anyone who has waited too long for a pedestrian light.
entries.target: 城市系统实验室研究简报。写给城市缔造者、服务设计师，以及每一个在斑马线前等得太久的人。

entries.source: ABSTRACT
entries.target: 摘要

entries.source: Cities are loud not only because of traffic. They are loud because every surface asks for attention: a screen in the elevator, a ping from the parking meter, an app that wants us to rate a bench. This brief looks at what happens when public technology is designed to ask for less.
entries.target: 城市之所以喧闹，不只因为车流。它喧闹，是因为每一处表面都在索取注意力：电梯里的屏幕、停车计费器的提示音、一个请你给长椅打分的应用。本简报探讨：当公共技术被设计成少问一点，会发生什么。

entries.source: The attention tax
entries.target: 注意力的隐形税

entries.source: A quieter interface
entries.target: 更安静的界面

entries.source: Every notification, kiosk and blinking status light takes something from the people around it. Most of that cost never appears on a budget sheet. It appears as a parent who misses a train, a visitor who gives up on a map, or a neighbour who stops reading the noticeboard.
entries.target: 每一次通知、每一个自助终端、每一盏闪烁的状态灯，都在从周围的人身上拿走一点什么。这笔成本很少出现在预算表上，却会表现为错过一班车的家长、放弃看地图的访客，或不再读公告栏的邻居。

entries.source: Calm technology does not mean technology that disappears. It means technology that knows when to stop talking. A crossing signal that simply waits. A library app that opens on the book you were reading, not on a promotion.
entries.target: 安静的技术，并不意味着技术必须消失。它意味着技术知道何时停止说话：一个只是静静等待的路口信号；一个打开时直接回到你上次读到的那一页、而不是促销页面的图书馆应用。

entries.source: The shift is small in code and large in culture. It asks teams to measure the interruptions they remove, not only the features they ship.
entries.target: 这种转变在代码里很小，在文化里却很大。它要求团队衡量自己消除了多少打扰，而不只是发布了多少功能。

entries.source: More information is not the answer. Attention is not a resource that can be topped up indefinitely; it is a civic condition.
entries.target: 更多的信息并不是答案。注意力不是可以无限续杯的资源；它是一种公共条件。

entries.source: "The best interface may be the one that asks the least of us and still leaves us more capable than before."
entries.target: “最好的界面，也许是对我们索取最少的那个——却仍让我们比从前更有能力。”

entries.source: A working principle for public-interest technology.
entries.target: 面向公共利益的技术，一条工作原则。

entries.source: PRINCIPLES
entries.target: 原则

entries.source: THREE WORKING PRINCIPLES
entries.target: 三条工作原则

entries.source: Three principles for quieter systems
entries.target: 让系统安静下来的三个原则

entries.source: Calm technology is not a style of screen. It is a set of decisions about when a system should speak, how it should move, and what it should leave to the person in front of it.
entries.target: 安静的技术不是某种屏幕风格。它是一组取舍：系统何时开口、如何行动，以及应该把什么留给站在它面前的人。

entries.source: Speak only when spoken to
entries.target: 只在被问到时开口

entries.source: A calm system defaults to silence. It does not celebrate every login, nudge every inactive account or turn a routine confirmation into a full-screen event. The default state should be quiet enough that a message means something when it arrives.
entries.target: 安静的系统默认保持沉默。它不会为每次登录喝彩，不会催促每一个不活跃的账户，也不会把一次例行确认变成全屏事件。默认状态应当足够安静，让一条消息在真正到来时仍然有意义。

entries.source: Move at the speed of trust
entries.target: 以信任的速度运行

entries.source: Good urban services arrive on time and then get out of the way. They show their working, keep a human channel open and never make an irreversible decision on behalf of someone who has not been asked. Trust is built in the pauses as much as in the promises.
entries.target: 好的城市服务准时出现，然后让到一边。它们展示自己的依据，保留一条人工通道，也绝不会替一个没有被询问过的人做出不可逆的决定。信任既建立在承诺里，也建立在那些停顿里。

entries.source: Leave room for the human
entries.target: 给人留出余地

entries.source: Automation should make the next human action easier, not make it unnecessary. A form that remembers, a map that admits uncertainty, a service that hands over cleanly to a person: these are quiet forms of respect, and they scale better than any notification.
entries.target: 自动化应当让人的下一步更容易，而不是让这一步变得不必要。一个会记得你的表单、一张承认不确定性的地图、一次干净地交接给真人的服务——这些都是安静形式的尊重，也比任何通知更能扩展。

entries.source: A city feels calm when its systems remember that people are not tasks.
entries.target: 当系统记得人不是任务，城市才会显得安静。
